recommendations.headline: Call satisfaction is the single biggest lever on sales: satisfied calls convert at 71% vs only 15% for neutral and 5% for dissatisfied calls, yet only 36% of calls (968/2715) are rated satisfied and reps leave price undiscussed in 71% of calls (1922/2715).
behaviour: Price-focused behaviour dominates: price_shopper is the top behaviour tag (467 calls), comparing_quotes (280) and price_enquiry is the top intent (926, 34% of all calls).
Most calls end undecided: callback is the outcome in 1258 calls (46%) vs only 525 orders (19%) and 416 unclear (15%).
Urgency is lower than underlying need: only 357 calls (13%) are high urgency even though fast_delivery is the #1 stated need (493 mentions).
A sizeable loyal base exists but is under-leveraged: repeat_buyer (244) and bulk_buyer (236) behaviours are common, yet only 22 calls show loyal_to_us and 30 are referrals.
Dealers are 47% of calls (1278) and convert best (40% win), while 'unknown' segment calls (1009, 37% of volume) convert worst (25%) - segment isn't being captured early enough.
satisfaction: Satisfaction strongly predicts outcome: satisfied calls win 71% of the time vs 15% for neutral and just 5% for dissatisfied (968/1397/228 calls respectively).
Price is rarely actually discussed: 71% of calls (1922) show 'not_discussed' price reaction, despite price_high being the top objection (363 calls, 13%).
When price IS discussed, most customers accept it: 293 'accepted' vs only 84 'too_high' - suggesting price itself is less of a blocker than how/when it's communicated.
Rep execution gaps are driving dissatisfaction: slow_or_unclear_answer (442 calls) and no_follow_up_fixed (423 calls) are the two most common missed actions.

conversion.title: Lock in a fixed follow-up time on every call
conversion.evidence: no_follow_up_fixed is the 2nd most common rep gap (423 calls) and callback is the outcome in 46% of calls (1258)
conversion.action: Reps must state and log a specific callback date/time before ending any non-order call; managers to audit CRM for 'vague callback' entries weekly.

conversion.title: Speed up and clarify price/technical answers
conversion.evidence: slow_or_unclear_answer is the #1 missed action (442 calls); needs_technical_help (402) and technical_advice need (450) are top customer needs
conversion.action: Give reps a quick-reference rate/spec sheet per product line and script 2-3 standard technical answers for common specs (thickness, GSM, size).

conversion.title: Send a written quote on every price enquiry
conversion.evidence: no_quote_sent happened in 258 calls while price_enquiry is the top intent (926 calls, 34%)
conversion.action: Make it mandatory to send a WhatsApp/quote PDF within the same call or within 1 hour, tracked as a KPI.

conversion.title: Always ask for the order after quoting
conversion.evidence: didnt_ask_for_order occurred in 250 calls; order outcome is only 19% (525/2715)
conversion.action: Train reps to end every price/product discussion with a direct closing question ('Shall I book this for you?').

conversion.title: Offer alternatives immediately when stock is short
conversion.evidence: stock_availability is the 2nd top objection (360 calls, win rate only 25%) and didnt_offer_alternative occurred 153 times
conversion.action: Maintain a live alternate-brand/size substitution list so reps can pivot instantly instead of losing the call.

conversion.title: Capture customer segment at call start
conversion.evidence: 'unknown' segment is 37% of calls (1009) but converts at only 25% vs 40% for identified dealers
conversion.action: Add a mandatory first-minute question to tag caller type (dealer/fabricator/contractor/end-user) in the CRM.

conversion.title: Use a satisfaction checklist in QA reviews
conversion.evidence: Win rate gap between satisfied (71%) and neutral (15%)/dissatisfied (5%) calls is the largest swing factor in the data
conversion.action: Managers to spot-check calls weekly against a short courtesy/clarity/follow-through checklist and coach reps scoring low.

offers.title: On-demand cutting & sizing service
offers.why: cutting_processing is a top-10 need (113 mentions) and several well-run calls involved urgent custom cuts (e.g., 15ft slitting, before-lunch cut-to-size delivery).

offers.title: Express/same-day delivery slot for urgent orders
offers.why: fast_delivery is the #1 need (493) and urgent_buyer is a top behaviour (290); multiple successful calls hinged on before-lunch or same-day delivery.

offers.title: Sample & test-certificate pack for new/technical buyers
offers.why: samples (72) and test_certificate (22) needs recur, and quality_doubt objection (101 calls) has a below-average 26% win rate.

offers.title: Structured advance + balance-on-delivery payment option
offers.for_whom: Customers raising needs_credit (103) or credit_terms objection (80, which has the best objection win-rate at 29%)
offers.why: Many successful calls already used 50% advance/balance-at-delivery informally - formalize it as a stated convenience.

offers.title: Priority stock reservation for bulk/repeat dealers
offers.for_whom: Bulk_buyer (236) and repeat_buyer (244) segments, especially dealers (40% win rate)
offers.why: consistent_supply (126) and stock_availability (490) are top needs; reserving stock reduces lost sales from availability objections (360 calls, 25% win).

offers.title: Formal seasonal scheme/gift program
offers.why: Successful calls reference gift/welding-rod schemes positively, while unresolved calls show frustration over missed Diwali gifts - formalizing this protects goodwill.

loyalty.title: Consider a tiered loyalty/rewards program
loyalty.how: Award points or recognition (not discounts) based on order volume/frequency, redeemable for priority service or gifts
loyalty.why: repeat_buyer (244) and bulk_buyer (236) are large segments but loyal_to_us is tagged only 22 times and referral only 30 - loyalty isn't being reinforced.

loyalty.title: Consider dedicated relationship contact for top dealers
loyalty.how: Assign a named rep/manager to high-volume dealers for all queries and updates
loyalty.why: Dealers are 47% of calls and the highest-converting segment (40% win); regular_updates is a top-5 need (215 mentions).

loyalty.title: Consider priority processing queue for repeat/bulk customers
loyalty.how: Fast-track order confirmation, dispatch and documentation for identified repeat/bulk buyers
loyalty.why: bulk_buyer (236) and consistent_supply need (126) suggest these customers value reliability over price negotiation.

loyalty.title: Consider proactive price/stock update broadcasts
loyalty.how: Send scheduled WhatsApp updates on rates and stock to repeat dealers instead of waiting for inbound calls
loyalty.why: regular_updates need (215) is notable and many calls show customers simply asking 'has rate changed' - proactive info reduces friction.

loyalty.title: Consider an easy document-access service
loyalty.how: Maintain quick-retrieval system for invoices, test certificates and PO copies on request
loyalty.why: Multiple calls show customers requesting invoice PDFs, bill copies and test certificates with delays - documentation ease builds trust without discounting.

loyalty.title: Consider consistent seasonal gifting calendar
loyalty.how: Plan and communicate gift/scheme timing in advance to avoid gaps
loyalty.why: Calls show dissatisfaction when expected Diwali gifts did not arrive, impacting relationship with otherwise loyal dealers.

non_price_benefits.title: Fast, reliable delivery including same-day/before-lunch options
non_price_benefits.why: fast_delivery is the top need (493) and multiple successful calls were won purely on delivery speed commitments.

non_price_benefits.title: Custom cutting and sizing capability
non_price_benefits.why: cutting_processing need (113) and several successful calls involved precise cut-to-length/slitting requests.

non_price_benefits.title: Strong technical/product guidance
non_price_benefits.why: technical_advice is a top need (450) and needs_technical_help is the 2nd most common behaviour (402).

non_price_benefits.title: Reliable stock availability and alternatives
non_price_benefits.why: stock_availability need (490) is the 2nd highest; offering substitutes drove successful outcomes (e.g., Radiance unavailable -> Color On Plus accepted).

non_price_benefits.title: Quality assurance with documentation (test certificates)
non_price_benefits.why: quality_doubt objection (101 calls, 26% win) and test_certificate/quality_assurance needs show customers value proof of quality.

non_price_benefits.title: Flexible, transparent payment process
non_price_benefits.why: needs_credit (103) and credit_terms objection has the best win rate among objections (29%), showing payment flexibility already helps close deals.

top_questions.question: What is the rate/price for this product?
top_questions.answer_tip: Confirm exact spec, brand and quantity first, then give a clear rate verbally and follow up immediately with a written quote on the same call.

top_questions.question: Can you reduce the price / match competitor pricing?
top_questions.answer_tip: Avoid open-ended negotiation; pivot to value points like delivery speed, cutting service, stock reliability and quality certification.

top_questions.question: Do you have stock / is this available right now?
top_questions.answer_tip: Check live stock before answering; if unavailable, immediately offer the closest available alternative rather than leaving customer waiting.

top_questions.question: Can this be delivered today/tomorrow/by a specific time?
top_questions.answer_tip: Give a firm time commitment rather than 'will check and call back'; escalate urgent requests internally right away.

top_questions.question: Can you send the quotation/photos on WhatsApp?
top_questions.answer_tip: Send during or immediately after the call rather than deferring to 'later' - this is a top missed-action gap.

top_questions.question: What thickness/brand/spec is best for my need?
top_questions.answer_tip: Ask about the application (roofing type, site conditions) before recommending, and explain clearly using simple comparisons.

top_questions.question: What are your credit/advance payment terms?
top_questions.answer_tip: Explain the standard advance + balance-on-delivery process clearly and consistently so customers know what to expect.

top_questions.question: Can you provide invoice copies or test certificates?
top_questions.answer_tip: Confirm this is standard practice and commit to a specific turnaround time for sending the documents.
